quickref.weapon: New 2026 Astoria weapon A (unnamed; navy bottle-scope rifle)

quickref.look: HUD icon only: long dark-navy rifle (~#2A3C56) with a pale stripe (~#C2CBEA), black box muzzle, a light-blue capped-bottle scope (~#96C6E0), black grip, a cream block with two dots, a big dark-red oval stock (~#8E0C1E) [Observed, HKbwq7PolNc maxres2]

quickref.status: Fan claim of 'two new weapons for Astoria' (InstableGR); SkyVu only says 'a couple of surprises' [Canon]
BBG 2.11 (Aug 27, 2014); in the Aug 2026 beta, build 3.0.0, with a 4-round clip [Observed, B-8uQcs1DFA]
quickref.look: Red barrel with gold characters, black and yellow receiver, grey paint hopper, brush tip (2026 HUD icon) [Observed]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Manual aim, no lock; one long thin straight rainbow-banded beam: magenta #F122CC, violet #A829F4, blue #305AEA, sky #35AFFF, cyan #39F2ED, green #58F75C, yellow #F8F41F, orange #F8680F, red #DC211C [Observed, rnbGzc0Gm0g 2016]

quickref.status: BBG 2.6 (Dec 20, 2013); seen in 2022 and 2023 fan footage; 2026 unverified
quickref.look: Copper tube with a pink chevron and stripe, purple bands, angular pink-lipped muzzle (HUD icon) [Observed]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Manual aim; thin pale cream-yellow straight streak (~#FDFBDF) [Observed low-res; attribution Inference]; the dart itself unresolved
quickref.impact_end_result: White blade-like shard starburst plus a large pale-cyan dome (~#B3E4E1/#BAFEFC) with the victim flung into the air [Observed; that it is the Blow Dart is Inference, strong]; 6 s fuse per wiki

quickref.look: White unicorn-head crossbow with a lavender horn [Observed]
quickref.firing_and_projectile: Thin lavender line; while charging, a glittery pink-violet aura plus pink and white star sparkles at the muzzle [Observed; that it is the charge is Inference]
quickref.impact_end_result: Charged AoE burst not observed [Unverified]; wiki: AoE, can self-kill
